sermon.title: How Do Some Civil Leaders Get into Office? — August 30, 2020
sermon.speaker: Pastor David G. Kincer
sermon.summary: Pastor David G. Kincer defends America’s founders and calls abortion and same-sex marriage unrighteous decrees. He teaches that the Most High rules in the kingdom of men, setting up and removing kings and even using evil rulers to correct His people. He reads Matthew 24 as fulfilled in Jerusalem’s fall and points to the coming great restoration.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added from the speaker’s pauses and then corrected by hand, and obvious caption errors (names, Bible references) were fixed; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear.

scriptures.text_nkjv: For a righteous man may fall seven times And rise again, But the wicked shall fall by calamity.

faqs.question: Who sets up and tears down kings?
faqs.answer: God does; the Most High rules over every government of men.

faqs.question: Is the great tribulation what Christians look forward to?
faqs.answer: No. He says the great tribulation isn’t one of them; it’s the great restoration.
